title.rendered: Observability and Large Networks Monitoring Webinar (Video and Slides)

content.rendered:
Today we have run our webinar that was divided in two distinct sections. Below you can find both the video and the presentation slides.

Stay tuned as the next webinar will be scheduled soon and we’ll be talking about AI.

Enjoy !

High-Resolution Observability

ObservabilityDownload

Large Networks Monitoring

Routing & BGP for Large-Scale NetworksDownload
